_comment: The cards: the one source of every card's values, written by the card table (tools/cards/hq.py, which also keeps how settled each value is in tools/cards/levels.json). A card belongs to no deck: the decks (starters and bot decks) are lists over this pool in decklists.json. Effect logic lives in engine code (effects/statics/strength), bound by id; numbers an effect uses live in engine/config.py. Schema: cards: id (unique, stable), name, status (collectible: a card a deck may hold; reserve: a shelved design or a later habitat's card; tutorial: the tutorial's fixed deal; token: made by an effect, never in a decklist; planned: an animal and habitat waiting for a design, which the engine doesn't load), rarity, tags (families and roles), base_strength (int 0-10, or 'dynamic' with dynamic_strength), keywords (the printed static keywords, read from the text by hq.py), hungry (its number), food_cost (a printed 'Costs X food'), text (verbatim), related (the cards it makes), evolves, mate (the Eagle pair), stage, unnamed (a legendary waiting for its name), species, habitat.
